items.title: Harry Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: I mean I like Sonny Rollins because he had such a wonderful sound, you know he had a great sound.

ctx.x: Why aren’t there more people that are disciples of Sonny Rollins? Who knows? I mean I like Sonny Rollins because he had such a wonderful sound, you know he had a great sound.
How did he get that sound, you know, he almost sounds like he’s growling into the horn at times.
